app.quit.what: Close the workbench, stopping firmware on the way out.

map.centre.what: Point the map at a node, or at a latitude and longitude.

params.name: node
params.what: centre on this node instead of giving coordinates

map.fit.what: Zoom the map so every node is on it.

node.output.what: read what a node's serial port, emulator or radio model has printed

params.name: source
params.what: serial, emulator or radio; serial by default

params.name: lines
params.what: how many lines of the tail to answer with, up to 2000

node.window.what: Open one node's own window, the thing people put on a second monitor.

params.name: tab
params.what: which tab to open on; the window's default when absent

node.wipe.what: erase one node's stored state: its flash, its card and its files

params.name: node
params.what: the node to put back to factory

panels.list.what: Name every panel the interface has registered.

ui.keep_above.what: Say whether a window popped out of the workbench stays above it, and report the setting either way.

params.name: on
params.what: set it; omit to read the current setting without changing it

workspace.set.what: Show one of the workbench's top-level views.

params.name: view
params.what: the view's name, as panels.list and the view bar spell it
